messages:
mira: Dropped a small playground tweak: examples now show a provenance badge (manual / suggested) and a compact preview in run history. Need quick UX + a11y sanity check.

jon: Saw it. Quick question: are suggested examples read-only by default? We don't want accidental edits.

mira: Suggested will be read-only with a 'Use copy' action that creates a manual editable copy. Manual examples remain editable inline.

ravi: Inline edit works well but keyboard flow is off. Tab lands in the edit icon before the preview text. I think order should be: pill -> preview -> actions.

zoe: Contrast nit: provenance badges use neutral-100 bg with light text on hover, fails AA. Recommend bg token-info-100 and text token-info-800 for sufficient contrast.

jon: Copy nit for badge: use short nouns, e.g. 'Manual' / 'Suggested' (capitalized) and tooltip: 'Suggested by Playground based on common prompts'.

mira: Good. Also added aria-labels: "Example preview" on preview and "Provenance: suggested" on badges. Are we missing live region announcements when a suggested example is converted to manual?

ravi: Yes please add aria-live polite announcing "Example copied for editing" so screen reader users know the copy action succeeded.

ci-bot: CI: playground-examples-provenance-1745609999 passed accessibility checks (automated) :white_check_mark: 

zoe: For animations, keep expansion collapsed/expand to 100ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also ensure focus is set to the new editable textarea after 'Use copy'.

jon: Small UX ask: add a filter in run history to hide suggested examples by default, toggle labeled 'Include suggested examples'.

mira: I'll implement contrast token swap, aria-live, focus behavior, and the filter toggle. Planning to merge after another quick review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
